title: Cross-species single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals conservation and divergence of the cardiac macrophage response to myocardial injury

materials_reviewed.notes: Parsed full text from PDF and review_md. Cross-species cardiac injury mono/Mϕ response reviewed.
Methods on cryoinjury, cross-species alignment (Seurat, LIGER), flow cytometry, and HCR reviewed.
Fig. 1 (cardiac injury scRNA-seq), Fig. 2 (mouse subclusters), Fig. 3 (zebrafish subclusters, HCR for moxd1/gda/havcr1), Fig. 4-6 reviewed.
Supplementary Figs. 3, 5 and Supplementary Data 6 checked.

cluster_inventory: Zebrafish cardiac and extracardiac clusters (mono/Mphi clusters 1-7, epicardial/fibroblasts, mural, NK/T, thrombocytes, neutrophils)
Mouse cardiac macrophage clusters (mm1 to mm6)
